research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: New Relic is researching systems for processing coherent data, as described in 'System for processing coherent data,' which details a monitoring system that presents metrics or event data by monitoring state information from agents on computing systems. Additionally, 'Automation solutions for event logging and debugging on kubernetes' focuses on methods for linking and navigating data from distributed application clusters using edge modules and BPF probes. These areas highlight research in system monitoring and distributed application debugging.

about_short_description.short_description: New Relic is a digital intelligence company that delivers full-stack visibility and analytics to enterprises.

product.name: New Relic Intelligent Observability Platform
product.description: A cloud-based observability platform that correlates telemetry across applications, infrastructure, user experiences, logs, security, and AI systems to identify causes of performance and reliability issues.

product.name: Application Performance Monitoring (APM 360)
product.description: Application monitoring that provides end-to-end visibility into application and service performance, helping teams connect technical issues to customer experience, revenue, and developer productivity.

product.name: Digital Experience Monitoring
product.description: Monitoring for web and mobile user experiences that helps organizations identify performance problems, usability friction, errors, and simulated journey failures affecting customer satisfaction and conversions.

product.name: AI Observability
product.description: Monitoring for AI applications, models, and agent interactions that tracks performance, reliability, behavior, and token usage to help organizations operate AI systems safely and control costs.

product.name: Infrastructure Monitoring
product.description: Monitoring for hybrid, cloud, container, Kubernetes, database, and network infrastructure that correlates system health with application performance and operational events.

product.name: Log Management
product.description: A log observability service for searching, analyzing, correlating, and managing logs across technology environments, with options to query data in place and apply AI-assisted analysis.
